name: SslErrorPolicy
summary: SSL error handling policy for clients. Controls how certificate validation errors are handled.

subclasses.name: SslErrorPolicy.Strict
subclasses.description: Reject all certificate errors (default, recommended for production).

subclasses.name: SslErrorPolicy.AllowDomains
subclasses.description: Allow certificate errors only for the specified domains.

subclasses.name: SslErrorPolicy.AllowAll
subclasses.description: DANGEROUS: Allow ALL certificate errors for ALL domains. Development/testing only.

companionMethods.name: allowAll
companionMethods.description: Returns policy allowing all SSL errors.

companionMethods.name: allowDomains
companionMethods.description: Returns policy allowing SSL errors for given domains.

parameters.name: domains
parameters.description: Domain names or wildcard patterns to allow.

companionMethods.name: allowDomains
companionMethods.description: Returns policy allowing SSL errors for a set of domains.

parameters.name: domains
parameters.description: Set of domain names or wildcard patterns to allow.
